title: Macrocycle based dinuclear dysprosium(III) single molecule magnets with local D5h coordination geometry

material_class.structural_family: centrosymmetric rhomb-like Dy4 cluster with μ3-OH/μ-OH bridges and open-chain pyrazolate ligand L1

synthesis.procedure: One-pot template reaction: Dy(ClO4)3·6H2O (1 mmol) and 4-phenyl-3,5-dicarbaldehyde-1H-pyrazole (1 mmol) in 50 mL methanol were stirred and heated at 70 °C, then diethylenetriamine (1 mmol) in 20 mL methanol was added dropwise. After heating overnight at 70 °C the mixture was cooled to room temperature. A yellow precipitate was filtered, washed with methanol, and dried under vacuum. Yellow crystals of Dy4 were obtained by slow diffusion of diethyl ether into a DMF solution of the crude product.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot solution synthesis; crystallization by Et2O diffusion into DMF
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: yellow precipitate filtered, washed with methanol, dried under vacuum; yellow crystals by slow diffusion of diethyl ether into a DMF solution of the crude product

properties.summary: Dc χMT at 210 K is 52.97 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 56.68 for four free DyIII). χMT falls to 22.18 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K; Magellan analysis shows toroidal anisotropy axes along short Dy–μ-OH bonds, suggesting a diamagnetic/SMT-type ground state. Magnetization reaches 19.38 μB at 5 T, 2 K. Zero-field ac data show two overlapping χ'' peaks (9 and 14 K); 800 Oe suppresses the higher-T process. Fitted Ueff = 59.2 K (τ0 = 9.3e-6 s, slow) and 48.7 K (τ0 = 1.1e-5 s, fast) at 0 Oe, and Ueff = 46 K (τ0 = 1.2e-5 s) at 800 Oe.

measurements.conditions: 800 Oe dc field; τ0 = 1.2e-5 s; 3.0 Oe ac field

material_class.structural_family: dinuclear bis(pyrazolato) macrocycle with axial chlorides; local pentagonal-bipyramidal D5h DyN5Cl2

synthesis.procedure: In situ template reaction (Scheme 2): DyCl3·6H2O (1 mmol) and 3,5-diacetyl-4-methyl-1H-pyrazole (1 mmol) in 50 mL methanol were stirred and heated at 70 °C, then diethylenetriamine (1 mmol) in 20 mL methanol was added dropwise. The reaction was heated overnight at 70 °C, cooled to room temperature, solvent removed under vacuum, and the residue washed with ether. Colorless crystals were obtained by recrystallization from methanol.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: in situ one-pot solution synthesis; recrystallization from methanol
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent removed under vacuum; residue washed with ether; colorless crystals from methanol recrystallization

properties.summary: χMT = 27.63 cm3 K mol−1 at 210 K (expected 28.34 for two DyIII) and 13.70 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with antiferromagnetic Dy–Dy coupling. M = 10.24 μB at 5 T, 2 K. Zero-field ac χ'' lacks peaks; field-induced SMM behavior under 1200 Oe with Ueff = 19.1 K. Local D5h geometry with weak axial Cl donors.
